newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Five Brazil retail firms started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Five Brazil retail firms started.

text.p: HSBC James Capel said in a report it had initiated coverage of Brazilian retail firms Bompreco, Lojas Americanas, Globex and Makro with a hold rating.
-- also said it had initiated coverage of Brazilian retailer Lojas Renner as a buy.

-- Regarding Bompreco, HSBC James Capel said the company is "an attractive means of gaining exposure to growth in food retailing in an undeveloped region of Brazil, but it looks expensive in relation to the sector."
-- also said "the question of how much the costly acquisition of SuperMar will add to shareholder value remains unanswered."
-- Bompreco, a leading food retailer in Brazil's northeast, has just bought regional supermarket chain Supermar. Bompreco is 50 percent owned by Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV.

-- Concerning Lojas Americanas, it said it believes the company is fairly valued for 1997 "but the 1998 story still depends on whether it can put together a restructuring program dependent on numerous uncertain variables."
-- "Investors prepared to accept a high risk should note our 1998 price target of $22.5, suggesting a 51 percent upside in the longer term," it added.

-- HSBC James Capel also said Globex Utilidades and Makro were fairly priced. "We believe Globex is fairly valued at current prices, especially in the light of the substantial premium over competitor Lojas Arapua."
-- Makro, in turn, is fairly priced considering prospect growth, it said.

-- "Makro is trying to recover the profitability lost in 1995 which reflected in 1996 as well. The old strategy of focusing on the leisure business customer, as well as cost reduction, should be the main source of growth," it said.

-- And regarding Lojas Renner, HSBC James Capel said "the company's expansion in Sao Paulo state will establish it as a leading deparment store in Brazil, and foresee a 28 percent a year-end price appreciation potential."
-- Globex preferred was up 0.06 percent at 17.50 reais, Lojas Americanas preferred was flat at 16.30 reais and Makro, Lojas Renner and Bompreco were untraded at 1203 local/1503 GMT in Sao Paulo.
